answer: A sybil tax charges every new identity a non-refundable fee to trade. Each agent burns a 20-unit stake on entry, then climbs toward the summit of full trading rights. One walnut is easy to crack, but 1,000 cost 20,000 units, more than a forger could skim from the reef of honest traders. Honest agents pay once and keep rewards undiluted; idle clones lose their fee. The cheapest strategy is to be one real agent.
